name: A-Identity Trust Oracle
description: Before one AI agent pays another, it calls A-Identity to verify the counterparty. Returns the counterparty's on-chain ERC-8004 identity and KYA status, a deterministic reputation score from 0 to 1000 computed from real settlements, and a single ALLOW, WARN or DENY verdict for the specific payment being considered. Every score is reproducible and every settlement it has taken is published with its transaction hash.

supportedInterfaces.description: Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP. 23 tools covering identity, reputation, policy and hiring.
Pay-per-call HTTP tools. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with the payment requirements; the resource is served on a paid retry.

extensions.description: Payment is settled per call in USDC over x402. No account, no API key, no subscription.
Agent identity is an ERC-8004 on-chain passport, not a self-declared profile.

x402.description: Per-call payment in USDC. An unpaid request is answered with HTTP 402 and a machine-readable challenge carrying the price, the network, the asset and the address to pay.

skills.name: Verify an agent's identity
skills.description: Returns an agent's on-chain ERC-8004 registration and its KYA status, which is the agent proving control of its own wallet, recorded on-chain rather than self-declared.
examples: Is agent #849980 a real registered agent, and has it proved it controls its wallet?

skills.name: Score an agent's reputation
skills.description: A deterministic score from 0 to 1000 computed from real on-chain settlements, validation and tenure, with a recency decay and a Sybil check. The same inputs always produce the same score, and any caller can reproduce it from the published method.
examples: What is agent #849980's reputation, and what drove the number?

skills.name: Decide whether a payment should go through
skills.description: A pre-transaction verdict on a counterparty: ALLOW, WARN or DENY, with the reasons that produced it. Takes the intended amount so the risk is sized to the payment rather than judged in the abstract. It also takes a NEAR testnet account, written near:testnet:<id> or as a name ending in .testnet: the verdict is the one the NEAR SDK computes from NEAR testnet, read live at one block, and is free at https://a-identity.xyz/api/near/check (testnet only; nothing settles on NEAR yet).
examples: I am about to pay agent #849980 twenty five dollars. Should I?

skills.name: Check both sides of a proposed deal
skills.description: Inspects the payer and the payee together, which is how it catches same-operator self-dealing that a one-sided scan cannot see.
examples: Agent #6271 wants to pay agent #849980. Are these actually the same operator?

skills.name: Check an action against its owner's limits
skills.description: Runs the live policy engine over a proposed action and answers allow, ask a human, or block, naming the rule that decided it. Reports bands only: caps, allowlists and holdings are never disclosed.
examples: Does this agent operate under an enforced spend policy, and does it respect the verdicts?

skills.name: Fetch a full agent passport
skills.description: Identity, KYA, reputation and risk in a single call, for when a caller wants the whole picture rather than one answer.
examples: Give me everything you know about agent #849980.

skills.name: Free coarse trust band
skills.description: A free, rate-limited on-ramp returning a coarse trust band plus revoked and Sybil flags, so a caller can try the service before spending anything.
examples: Give me a quick read on agent #849980 before I pay for the full check.

note: ERC-8004 agents #1259 (Arbitrum One) and #73232 (Base) were registered by A-Identity but are held by the former operating wallet, which A-Identity retired on 2026-11-11. They are not ours and this card does not vouch for them, although their tokenURIs still point here. Our oracle validator revoked its feedback for both on 2026-11-17 (the transactions are in the provenance ledger at https://a-identity.xyz/proof). Never pay or fund their owner or their agent wallet. Arc testnet agent #849980 (Meridian) is ours, held by the founder's wallet since 2026-11-17, but it is a different agent: its tokenURI is its own inline metadata, not this file, so it is not one of this agent's registrations. Celo agent #9759 is ours too, held by the founder's wallet, but since 2026-11-19 its tokenURI is our Celo ERC-8004 registration file, https://a-identity.xyz/.well-known/celo-8004.json, which registers it, so it is listed there rather than here. Its first holder, 0xF43F...742D, is an address A-Identity retired on 2026-11-11: it is not A-Identity's, A-Identity does not vouch for it, and it must never be paid or funded.

services.name: A2A
services.description: This file, read as an A2A agent card. It validates against the A2A 0.3.0 AgentCard schema, the version named here. It is for discovery only: A-Identity serves no A2A message endpoint. The skills it lists are HTTP tools at the x402 interface in supportedInterfaces (POST /tools/<skill>), and four of them are also sold on Celo at the celo- services in this list.

services.name: celo-check
services.description: A web page where a person buys one risk_check on Celo mainnet from their own browser wallet. The wallet signs one EIP-3009 authorization in USDC and sends no transaction, and the answer is ALLOW, WARN or DENY with its reasons and the settlement hash.

services.name: celo-verify_agent
services.description: The verify_agent skill, sold per call in USDC on Celo mainnet over x402. A GET answers HTTP 402 with the price and the address to pay, and a paid POST returns the answer.

registrations.note: ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry on Arc Mainnet, the canonical address Base and Arbitrum One carry, minted the day Arc Mainnet opened (2026-09-16). Token #0 is the registry's first mint. Our x402 rails settle here in USDC. The explorer's pages open in a browser; only its JSON API turns non-browser clients away.
OKX.AI ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry on X Layer mainnet; the paid Trust Oracle was listed here until OKX.AI delisted it on 2026-09-26.
ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry on Robinhood Chain mainnet, deployed by the ERC-8004 authors rather than by us. Token #0 is the registry's first mint and it is ours; its tokenURI points back at this card.

ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry on Robinhood Chain testnet, the rehearsal network, at the testnet family address Arc testnet also uses. Token #0 is ours: registered 2026-08-11 by the former operating wallet 0xd305...ed36 and moved on 2026-11-17 to 0xCB88...1bdf, the founder's wallet (transferFrom tx 0x1d7a948c...), a move that cleared its agent wallet. Its tokenURI points back at this card. Testnet: no real money.
